summary:
Programme enrollment now keeps complete identities and Roadmap declarations private while authenticating them through the existing fixed protected public source. The public enrollment/v3 document contains exactly schema and one commitment digest. The private version-4 binding contains a 32-byte cryptographic nonce and canonical padded Base64 of exact UTF-8 enrollment-payload/v1 bytes. The closed payload binds target, constructor provenance, allowed repositories and every selected issue/node/Roadmap row. The digest hashes the ASCII domain, one NUL, decoded nonce, unsigned eight-byte big-endian payload length and original bytes, never a reserialization. No public per-item hashes, payload, nonce or private-derived metadata are required. Product binding3/schema1 remains unchanged and rejects the programme field; no raw-public programme fallback is retained.

Binding acquisition uses one bounded opened handle before allocation; binding and private payload limits are 256 KiB and 128 KiB, with depth16 and duplicate/unknown/missing/encoding refusal. The shared decoder authenticates exact bytes against protected source before selected issue/plan reads. A final protected-main/blob/digest barrier follows slow inspection and remains before Observation writes and Verified no-ops. Failed currentness or authentication withholds global population selection. Ephemeral integrator input additionally joins the same required enrollmentCommitmentSha256; inspection2 reports only the matched digest, or null when unmatched, and binds it through protected-input provenance. Private v4 report paths use restrictive existing directories, exclusive0600 files and existing Linux-x64 directory durability barriers. Reports remain private because their normal native issue facts can contain private identities.

The maintained offline BoardV2Import preparation route shares the runtime validator. It checks all inputs and the final encoded-envelope bound before one RNG call, then retains exclusive restrictive disjoint output files with file/directory flush and independent pair readback. Collisions and partial failures preserve originals without overwrite, deletion, retry or reseeding. Generated files are preparation only; protected commitment delivery and qualified installed executable provenance still establish later admission. The existing linear offline CI gate includes shared-source/build dependencies and retains its locked restore, tests and10-minute limit; static path checks suffice without a new model or credential route.

The current programme owning-issue model uses one complete inline or six-heading record. Missing, duplicate, mixed or ambiguous declarations remain gaps, and fenced examples cannot supply fields. Current deliverable preserves bounded native text: exact trimmed None declares no current work; real non-PR work and mixed references remain declarations rather than disappearing into an absent-PR case. Canonical selected-repository PR references are discovery hints independently joined to native identity/state/head and complete inventories. Malformed or foreign PR-shaped references refuse; ordinary deliverable links cause no new provider read. Next action and arbitrary history never manufacture a current owner or PR. Product3 keeps its separate behavior.

Every non-None declaration requires exactly one existing current-deliverable prerequisite for the proposed action, covered by fresh native issue/body/source, exact slice/attempt/owner and attributed observation joins. True means scoped reconciliation against duplication/conflict; it is not completion, acceptance, released custody or execution authority. False blocks; absent, duplicate, stale, mismatched or unreadable reconciliation withholds the affected selection. Native PR inventories, relevant uncertain original reservations, intake, scope and remaining capacity remain independent. Independent source work may proceed while later activation is pending; existing-work observation, review and qualification retain exact current native PR/head requirements. Activation remains under its separate executor. Missing legacy owner/current-action records remain item-specific gaps, never inferred ready.

This supersedes the earlier inspection description to correct a real maintained-input mismatch before prospective package qualification. Compilation, focused inert caller controls and retained private-input probes establish only their exact source scope. The private actual population and evidence remain outside public fixtures and Atlas. No protected enrollment, installed successor, remaining migration, UI, real-use or consumer adoption follows from source preparation. Original partial migration, consumed operations and .103 Unknown reservations remain unreplayed; unavailable-original evidence searches are not revived.

The semantic dbd candidate built without warnings/errors and passed targeted boundaries before full102 projection and71 CLI cases. The final bounded86 lexical refinement separately built and passed its targeted case and all71 affected CLI cases; prior projection results retain their dbd byte scope. A dbd compiled pure-function probe of retained private input preserves17 complete native declarations and owners exactly, leaving3 legacy records unresolved. It makes zero native calls and supplies neither protected authentication nor action reconciliation. Earlier formatting, classification and fixture-oracle failures remain retained. Four overwritten prior DLL paths are explicitly historical, not reconstructed. Source controls establish no current private readiness or package admission.
title: Current work declarations require scoped reconciliation; private enrollment remains authenticated
